logo.source: src/components/ui/Logo.tsx, mirrored in the carousel template

brand.source: src/app/globals.css — same tokens as the 103 carousel decks

shots.message: YusufCreates, as a mark that draws itself.
shots.brief: The chevron and arm draw on as strokes, the accent block lands with weight, then the wordmark resolves beside it. Ends on the locked-up brand with the handle. Reusable as an intro or outro sting on any other video.

beats.event: accent block drops in — the cause

shots.message: Your app works. It still looks cheap. Polish is decisions, not paint.
shots.brief: The strongest hook from the carousel set, as kinetic type. Line one lands flat and neutral; the turn lands in danger red; the resolution lands in accent purple. Word-level stagger, no line ever sits still.

beats.event: line 1 lifts away, line 2 enters mid-flight

shots.brief: A count-up from 0 to 400 as the hero number, then the ladder steps in beneath it — Growth, Web app, Native — each row arriving on its own beat. Ends on 'No request a quote.' Figures are real, from src/lib/pricing.ts.

beats.event: count-up 0 to 400 runs, scale eases with it

shots.message: Two build slots. Counted, not claimed.
shots.brief: A giant numeral 2 that arrives with weight, with two slot markers filling beside it. Real scarcity from convex/capacity.ts — BUILD_SLOTS = 2. The honesty is the hook: availability is derived from live projects, not a toggle.

beats.event: two slot bars fill in sequence

shots.message: Live in week one. Rough is fine. Invisible is not.
shots.brief: The process promise as kinetic type, with a progress rail that advances as the lines land — the rail is the sustained motion, so nothing waits. Ends on the promise in accent, then the lockup.

beats.event: line 1 lands as rail hits first mark

constraints: No idle wobble — every phase owns a sustained-motion route (motion-doctrine Part 2).
Stillness before climax: 0.3-0.75s comma before each payoff line.
No bounce.out or elastic.out. back.out(1.4-1.7) permitted on entry overshoot.
Every figure traceable: prices from src/lib/pricing.ts, slots from convex/capacity.ts.
Logo geometry copied verbatim from Logo.tsx — never redrawn by eye.
